overall_reason: A placeholder empty state ('No data / There is nothing to show.') floating centred under a decorative 'SECTION 01' label, with no explanation or next step: the default an agent writes when nobody designed the empty case.

findings.where: div.empty: h2 'No data', p 'There is nothing to show.'
findings.evidence: Failed T-FIVE-SECOND on 'what to do': the only content on the Reports page says there is nothing, twice ('No data' and 'There is nothing to show.' state one fact twice), with no reason and no action. T-FRESH-READER: both lines fit any app.
findings.before: No data / There is nothing to show.
findings.after: Say why it is empty and what makes reports appear, with one action: 'No reports yet. Reports appear after your first data import.' + button 'Import data' [DATA NEEDED: what populates Reports and the action that starts it]
findings.why: An empty state is a first-run screen; it should teach the next step, not restate the absence.

findings.evidence: T-EYEBROW: covering 'SECTION 01' (12px tracked caps) loses nothing; there is no section 02, no navigation and no section name. The sweep's numbered_labels and eyebrow detectors did not fire on it.
findings.after: Delete it, or replace with a real identifier (workspace or date range) [DATA NEEDED: report scope]
findings.why: Decorative section numbering is a template tell with no job.

findings.evidence: The page header is left-aligned at x 373 while the empty block is centred in the 727px column, so it floats mid-page detached from the heading; the remaining ~700px below is blank (tile 1440-00).
findings.before: text-align: center empty block under a left-aligned header
findings.after: Align the empty state to the content's left edge, or give it a bordered region the size of the eventual report list so it reads as that list's empty state
findings.why: Headings sit with their content; a floating centred message reads as unfinished.

strengths: Copy is short and literal, with no slop diction; type and colour tokens are clean and contrast is high.
not_investigated: Whether reports can exist at all (loading vs error vs truly empty) cannot be told from one static state.
